rows.grounds: instrumental plural of sarvamantra; all mantras

items.question: What mantra repetition and consecration are prescribed for a calf after it is placed in a protected clay pot?
premises: The act is repeated once once.
items.inference: The calf receives a single consecration with all mantras followed by a doubled repetition.
uncertainties: The exact ritual referent of vatsa is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Consecrate the calf once with all mantras, then once again.
